title: Grid header checkbox: a partial selection is announced as mixed but drawn as a check mark
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed split. Triage on #27520 (6495077487) said: 「Each row is either taken, with its own card where it needs code」. This card is row 4.
Business reason: with some rows selected, the header checkbox looks the same as "all selected". A user who means to act on two rows may read the header as "all ten are in" and run a bulk action on what they think is the whole page, or clear the selection by mistake.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/components`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "header select-all checkbox indeterminate mixed state draws check mark instead of dash" → 1 hit, #27519 (Studio checkbox field drawn as a toggle). That is unrelated. **New.**

## What happens (row 4 of #27520, 18.3.0 RC walkthrough at `c4c515ad`)

Admin, desktop, Tasks → Bulk Actions view, 2 of 10 rows selected. The header checkbox correctly carries `aria-checked="mixed"`, but it draws a check mark.

## Mechanism (read on `origin/main`, not reproduced here)

- `ui/packages/components/src/ui/checkbox.tsx`: Radix's `CheckboxPrimitive.Indicator` renders for both `checked` and `indeterminate`, and its only child is `<Check />`. So the mixed state draws the same glyph as checked. Its fill classes key on `data-[state=checked]` only.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` ~L3146 passes `checked={… somePageRowsSelected ? 'indeterminate' : false}`.
- ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` is a No-Touch zone (ui/AGENTS.md #7: upstream shadcn files overwritten by sync). The fix belongs in a wrapper or at the call site, not in `ui/checkbox.tsx`.

## Expected

The mixed state draws a dash, distinct from the check mark, wherever the shared checkbox is driven to `'indeterminate'`. Checked and unchecked are unchanged.

## Acceptance

- One measured repro on current `main` first: name the view's actual renderer (data-table or the grid plugin) and every call site that passes `'indeterminate'`.
- A test: with a partial selection the header draws the dash glyph and not the check, and `aria-checked="mixed"` holds. Controls: all selected draws the check; none selected draws nothing. Include an ablation.
- ⛔ No edit under `ui/packages/components/src/ui/**`.

Links back: #27520 (row 4)
